description: Release uploads held for review (see `list_held`): pass `keys`, or `pr`/`issue` to approve every held file there. The file returns at the same URL and the managed PR comment re-syncs. Check the file first: if it shows a real credential, rotate it and delete the file instead of approving. Same as `uploads approve`.

issue.description: Approve every held file on this issue. Mutually exclusive with pr.

pr.description: Approve every held file on this pull request. Mutually exclusive with issue.

workspace.description: Override the workspace for this call (like the CLI's --workspace flag).

name: approve
title: Approve held files
